params.caption: 🎮 GDC survey: 1 in 3 game devs laid off in two years A new GDC survey found that one in three games industry professionals were laid off in the past two years — more than in its previous report. Over half of those are still unemployed, and a quarter have applied for at least 100 jobs. 🕒 Nov 12, 2026 · 20:04 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: VGC 💔 React if this worries you · 💬 What should studios change? #GDC #GameDev #Layoffs #GamingNews
